data.name: Real RC: Flight Simulator Aircraft Remote Control 2026
data.detailed_description:
In Real Flight Simulator: RC Aircraft Model Remote Control 2026, experience breathtaking graphics with rich vegetation, dynamic wind systems, and accurate physics. Every detail immerses you in a real simulation that shows the power of a PC flight simulator.

Take command of more than 144 aircraft. Fly trainers, gliders, commercial airliners, fighter jets, and WW1 and WW2 bombers. Try experimental prototypes and rare models, all built for a real simulation.

Customize your experience fully. Adjust the controls, fine-tune any aircraft, and create your own. Paint, draw, and apply decals on the surfaces of your planes to fly in your style on this flight simulator.

Test your skills in many missions. Fly through rings, pop balloons, and complete challenges. With your RC controller, you will feel the thrill of piloting. The world of real simulation is endless.

MAIN FEATURES:

  • 144 aircraft. Acrobatic, scale models, famous aircraft, commercial jets, historic fighters and bombers, and more.

  • 50 missions. Perform maneuvers, pop balloons, race through airpoles, and more.

  • Customizable aircraft skins.

  • True physics. Control surfaces, wind system, and radio modes.

  • Extra features by aircraft, including smoke, retractable gear, and flaps.

  • First and third person flight. Feel the power of a real simulation with an RC controller aircraft.

  • Joystick adjustments. Match the realism of a real airfield.

We built the ultimate PC experience for RC controller pilots and aviation fans. This is a full flight simulator for anyone who loves flying. Enjoy the most complete real simulation on PC.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 or 10 (64 Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 (AMD FX 8350) or better.
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD equivalent or greater
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Default

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64 Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 6700K equivalent or greater
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD equivalent or greater
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Default
